path: claude -p with stream-json input and output (newline-delimited JSON on standard input and output)

version.how: reported by the owner, who ran `claude --version`; the development session may not run the program and no sign-in or model turn exists here
version.fixtures: built from the documentation, not recorded

environment: DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS and XDG_RUNTIME_DIR (only for an account with a registered credential, so the key helper can reach the keyring)
mapped: control_request with the permission subtype, as a host approval
user message replay with our uuid, as the acknowledgment of an input
refused: any other control_request subtype is answered with an error response (the response shape is unverified)

unsupported.reason: the provider queues further user messages; there is no steer, so a second input becomes a queued message
the control request exists in the documentation but is not mapped in this phase

unsupported.operation: partial streaming events, MCP servers, hooks, slash commands, images and pasted content, forking, structured output

unverified: the subtype string of a permission request (assumed `can_use_tool`; the documentation names control_request and control_response but not this subtype)
the exact shape of the control_response that allows or denies a request
whether the provider accepts a user message on standard input before it emits system/init
the shape of the replayed user message that acknowledges an input (matched by uuid; `isReplay` is assumed)
the behavior of --resume together with stream-json input after the process died
how a run without a sign-in or with a failing apiKeyHelper reports the failure on the stream
the full list of result subtypes and of tool_result content shapes
whether queued user messages keep their order across an interrupted or failed turn
any real turn: nothing here was recorded from a running provider
